_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json; ADR-031 declarative-first (lifecycle on the schema, no XbrlReportService); ADR-022 cross-system integration via openconnector (Digipoort by source slug, no embedded SOAP/WS-Security client)
_meta.description: Tier-4 umbrella SBR/XBRL annual reporting capability for Shillinq. Declares a single XbrlInstance schema with a declarative draft → validated → submitted → accepted/rejected lifecycle (x-openregister-lifecycle, ADR-031); the schema is the transformation-result store for the FinancialStatement (T3) → NL-taxonomie XBRL mapping. The five canonical SBR entry points (kvk-jaarrekening, belastingdienst-vpb, belastingdienst-ib, sbr-banken-kredietrapportage, sbr-wonen) are enumerated on entryPoint. Digipoort submission is consumed from openconnector by source slug `digipoort-prod`; no Digipoort HTTP client, no WS-Security certificate handling, no SBR SOAP code ships in shillinq. The line → NL-taxonomie concept mapping consumes the OpenRegister Mapping abstraction; mapping seed templates ship under lib/Settings/seeds/sbr-mappings/ per entry point + taxonomy version and are imported idempotently by the OCA\Shillinq\Repair\InitializeSettings repair step. Sibling T3 changes (bookkeeping-vpb-mkb, bookkeeping-bcf-vat-compensation, bookkeeping-emu-reporting, bookkeeping-icp-opgaaf, bookkeeping-ib-aangifte-zzp) already declare entry-point-specific submission lifecycles; the XbrlInstance umbrella stores the canonicalised XBRL payload + Digipoort receipt + tamper-evidence hash for those flows.

XbrlInstance.title: XBRL Instance
XbrlInstance.description: An NL-taxonomie XBRL instance document derived from a posted T3 FinancialStatement. One record per filing event per administration + reporting period + entry point. Carries the canonicalised XML payload, its SHA-256 tamper-evidence hash, the resolved Mapping FK, the Digipoort acknowledgement receipt id when submitted, and the declarative draft → validated → submitted → accepted/rejected lifecycle (ADR-031). No re-aggregation of ledger lines; the instance is a pure transformation on top of FinancialStatement (D1 in design.md).

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration (tenant) owning this filing. IDOR scope key.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

instanceNumber.description: Sequential reference unique per administration + entry point + reporting period.
instanceNumber.title: Instance Number

entryPoint.description: Canonical SBR entry point. Each pins a Logius-published NL-taxonomie version.
entryPoint.title: Entry Point

taxonomyVersion.description: NL-taxonomie version pinned at generation. Stored on the instance so historical filings remain reproducible when a new taxonomy ships.
taxonomyVersion.title: Taxonomy Version

reportingPeriodStart.description: Start of the reporting period covered by this filing.
reportingPeriodStart.title: Reporting Period Start

reportingPeriodEnd.description: End of the reporting period covered by this filing.
reportingPeriodEnd.title: Reporting Period End

sourceStatementId.description: FK to the posted FinancialStatement (T3) record this XBRL instance derives from.
sourceStatementId.title: Source Statement ID

mappingId.description: FK to the OR Mapping record that resolves each FinancialStatement line to its NL-taxonomie concept.
mappingId.title: Mapping ID

instanceXml.description: Canonicalised XBRL instance document, stored as a UTF-8 string. Validates against the published NL-taxonomie schema for the entry point + reporting period.
instanceXml.title: Instance XML

instanceHash.description: SHA-256 of the canonicalised XML for tamper-evidence (: historical instances stay verifiable after mapping evolution).
instanceHash.title: Instance Hash

state.description: Lifecycle state. Transitions are declared in x-openregister-lifecycle below; no PHP XbrlReportService authors transitions (ADR-031).
state.title: State

digipoortReceiptId.description: Receipt id returned by Digipoort on submission acknowledgement. Required for the accepted state.
digipoortReceiptId.title: Digipoort Receipt ID

digipoortSourceSlug.description: Slug of the openconnector Source record that fronts the Digipoort gateway for this filing. No HTTP/SOAP code in shillinq: the source carries the WS-Security stack.
digipoortSourceSlug.title: Digipoort Source Slug

rejectionReason.description: Digipoort rejection text recorded when the submission moves to rejected.
rejectionReason.title: Rejection Reason

retention.description: SBR/XBRL filings retained 10 years per Archiefwet 1995 + fiscal bewaarplicht (Wet OB / Wet Vpb).

draft.label: Concept
draft.description: Operator-editable draft; the XBRL XML has been generated from the FinancialStatement + Mapping but not yet schema-validated.

validated.label: Gevalideerd
validated.description: XML validated against the published NL-taxonomie schema for the entry point + reporting period (guard).

submitted.label: Ingediend
submitted.description: Submitted to Digipoort via the openconnector source identified by digipoortSourceSlug. Awaiting acknowledgement.

accepted.label: Geaccepteerd
accepted.description: Digipoort returned status=accepted; the digipoortReceiptId is stored.

rejected.label: Afgewezen
rejected.description: Digipoort returned status=rejected with a rejectionReason; the operator may amend and re-submit.

validate.label: Valideer XBRL
validate.description: Validate the canonicalised XML against the NL-taxonomie schema for the entry point + reporting period.

submit.label: Indienen bij Digipoort
submit.description: Call the openconnector source by slug, attach instanceXml as the request body, persist the response receipt id. No Digipoort credentials are read from shillinq AppConfig.

accept.label: Digipoort accepteert
accept.description: Inbound Digipoort acknowledgement with status=accepted; sets digipoortReceiptId + acceptedAt.

reject.label: Digipoort wijst af
reject.description: Inbound Digipoort error; sets rejectionReason for operator amendment.

reopen.label: Heropen voor correctie
reopen.description: Operator reopens a rejected instance for editing + resubmission; audit-trail captures both submission attempts.

onSubmitted.description: Notify the bookkeeper when a filing is successfully submitted.

subject.nl: SBR/XBRL ingediend: instance {{instanceNumber}} ({{entryPoint}}) is verstuurd naar Digipoort
subject.en: SBR/XBRL submitted: instance {{instanceNumber}} ({{entryPoint}}) was filed with Digipoort

onRejected.description: Notify the bookkeeper when Digipoort rejects a submission.

subject.nl: SBR/XBRL afgewezen: instance {{instanceNumber}} ({{entryPoint}}) is afgewezen door Digipoort — {{rejectionReason}}
subject.en: SBR/XBRL rejected: instance {{instanceNumber}} ({{entryPoint}}) was rejected by Digipoort — {{rejectionReason}}

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a XBRL Instance is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.
